Resolves #19891

RealWorld2 mounts its views once again. Its `mainThreadAddons` replaced the default list and dropped `Navigator`. `PreviewList`, a `list.Base`, subscribes to Navigator on mount, so the mount threw halfway, and the next update inserted the home view's children a second time: two banners, 23 duplicate element ids, and an uncaught `subscribe` TypeError. Listing `Navigator` restores it.

Evidence: L3 (browser on a local dev server, before and after) → L3 required (AC-2 is a browser read). Residual: none.

`apps/**` gate: the diff is one entry in an app's `neo-config.json`. `src/DefaultConfig.mjs:180` (the default list) and `src/list/Base.mjs:343` (the consumer) are its siblings. No component, store, provider or model code is touched.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `apps/realworld2/neo-config.json` in this diff lists `Navigator` |
| AC-2 | Outside CI, browser: home on dev renders 2 banners with 23 duplicate ids plus the `subscribe` TypeError; with this line it renders 1 banner, 0 duplicate ids, no `subscribe` error. `#/editor` renders its form (title, about, body, tag chips, Publish) with 0 duplicate ids and no `subscribe` error |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive.

## Test Evidence
Local dev server, a fresh tab per load, duplicate ids counted with `querySelectorAll('[id]')`. That server's checkout predates #19883, so these loads still hit the dead backend (CORS and `json` errors). Those belong to the backend and were fixed separately; #19883 verified data loading.
